help.title: Æilus Value System Schema
help.schema: A schema shows how value (Æ) moves through converters and flows inside a system: what enters, what is transformed, what leaves.
help.converter: A functional block (team, service, subsystem) that receives value elements, transforms them and produces new ones. It can link to its BPMN process and to a more detailed schema of its own.
help.flow: A directed connection between converters or with the outside world: external input, external output or internal. Its width is a visual magnitude; colour and name are yours.
help.types: Each converter defines the types of value elements it produces: customer value, revenue, costs, risks, technical debt. A type is a definition with a polarity (value or anti-value), not an amount actually passed.
help.routing: A flow carries either all types of its source (including types added later) or only the selected ones. With "Selected" an empty list means no types at all. External inputs have no producer, so their types are not specified.
help.tools: Pan moves the canvas and moves single objects. Select picks converters with a frame; Shift or Ctrl adds or removes; dragging any selected converter moves the whole group. A click on empty space shows the schema properties. Ctrl + wheel or a pinch zooms at the cursor.
help.files: Open replaces the schema with a file after checking it. Merge adds another schema to this canvas as an independent copy with new ids, placed to the right. Export JSON keeps everything, including VET results; PNG is a picture, not a backup. Nothing is sent to the server.
help.vet: Select a flow and press "Estimate in VET": the Value Estimation Tool opens with this flow, you add concrete elements and estimate them, then "Save and return" brings the totals back onto the flow. The whole VET board is stored inside the schema file, so you can continue later.
help.ledger: Your Value Wallet records what was passed to whom and how the receiver valued it. In the flow panel, record a transfer along the flow or load the transfers you already have. The schema keeps only the short summary you allow in the wallet settings, as its own layer next to the VET estimate.
help.keys: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y redo, H hand, V arrow, Delete removes the selection, Esc cancels connecting.
